slides.0.title: Course Introduction
slides.0.content: Vouvray Sweet White × Cheese; Sancerre × Goat Cheese + Level 3 Assessment — This final lesson of Loire Level 3 covers all Level 3 AOCs, reviewing classic Loire wine-and-cheese pairings and completing the full Loire L3 knowledge assessment.
slides.1.title: Vouvray Sweet White × Cheese; Sancerre × Goat Cheese + Level 3 Assessment
slides.1.content:
This course systematically reviews all Level 3 AOC terroir characteristics, helping you build a solid Loire Valley knowledge framework. Classic pairings include: Vouvray Demi-Sec / Moelleux × washed-rind cheeses (Époisses, Munster); Sancerre × Crottin de Chavignol (iconic local goat cheese).

Through systematic study, you will be able to identify the typical styles of these AOCs and accurately describe their characteristics during tasting.
slides.2.title: Level 3 Final Assessment
slides.2.questions.0.question: Which best describes the scope of Loire Level 3?
slides.2.questions.0.options.0: All Loire Level 3 AOCs (Chenin Blanc whites, sparkling wines, sweet wines, Sauvignon Blanc, and satellite AOCs)
slides.2.questions.0.explanation: Loire Level 3 comprehensively covers Touraine's Chenin Blanc whites (Vouvray, Savennières), sweet wine AOCs (Coteaux-du-Layon, Quarts-de-Chaume, Bonnezeaux), sparkling wines (Crémant-de-Loire, Vouvray Mousseux), and Centre-Loire's Sauvignon Blanc world (Sancerre, Pouilly-Fumé and satellite AOCs). This is the most comprehensive module in the Loire course series.
